fusions.name: Reef Ambush
fusions.desc: Darts out up to 5 tiles onto an enemy for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds and stripping 10% of its armour for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spur Flick
fusions.desc: Grows 3 spurs of reef from your own claws and flicks them in a spread, each dealing 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each use costs 3% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Grown Cover
fusions.desc: Grows a reef wall 5 tiles long that nothing crosses for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Regrowing Hide
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
